evidence: Cyprus Scientific and Technical Chamber (ETEK) is a statutory council member.

evidence: Director of Public Works is an explicit statutory council member and Public Works is the lead on audit/inspection and road engineering measures.

evidence: Director of Road Transport Department is a statutory council member and the department is named for vehicle inspection and driver training.
qualification: Formal transport administration; operator associations not necessarily members

qualification: Digital/data coordination, not a fully integrated national platform

evidence: No named Ministry of Environment seat or attributed environmental-risk road-safety responsibility verified in statutory membership and strategy action tables.
qualification: N/A is unverified, not absence across Cyprus

evidence: Public Works, town planning, district administrations and municipalities are assigned 30 km/h areas, crossings and road engineering in the plan.

evidence: Ministry of Health director-general or authorized representative is named in the statutory council, and ministry leads post-crash care actions.
